description: This file defines a Factory class for dynamic registration and instantiation of classes and modules, primarily used within the Kivy framework. It includes class definitions, methods for registration, unregistration, and dynamic class retrieval, and loads additional factory registrations from an external module.

classes.name: FactoryException
classes.description: Custom exception class for factory-related errors.

classes.name: FactoryBase
classes.description: Main class implementing the factory pattern for dynamic class registration and instantiation.

methods.name: create_from
methods.description: Creates a new FactoryBase instance copying the classes from an existing factory.

methods.name: is_template
methods.description: Checks if a class is a template from kivy.lang.Builder.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new class or module with the factory, with options for templates and base classes.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Unregisters specified class names from the factory.

methods.name: unregister_from_filename
methods.description: Removes all factory entries associated with a specific filename.

methods.name: __getattr__
methods.description: Dynamically retrieves classes or modules registered with the factory, importing modules if necessary.
